description: Source code for accelerometer hardware interface and initialization on STM32F4Discovery, including SPI configuration, thread handling for sensor reading, and acceleration data retrieval.

methods.name: configureAccelerometerPins
methods.description: Configures GPIO pins for accelerometer SPI communication on STM32F4Discovery.

methods.name: initAccelerometer
methods.description: Initializes the accelerometer hardware, SPI interface, and starts a thread to read sensor data periodically.

methods.name: ivThread
methods.description: Thread function that continuously reads accelerometer X and Y data via SPI.

methods.name: getLongitudinalAcceleration
methods.description: Returns the current longitudinal acceleration value.

methods.name: getTransverseAcceleration
methods.description: Returns the current transverse acceleration value.
